goals: Maintain the selected Naturalist 2.0.3 Fabric gameplay roster on Minecraft Java 26.2.
Retain only animals, variant systems, eggs, Glow Goop, capture net, buckets, Knapsack, music discs, and their required assets/data; use vanilla replacements for retired custom material drops.
scope: Maintain the 26.2 persistence, rendering, behavior, egg/hatching, and client-item migrations for the retained roster.
Retain 49 entity types, 47 retained variant entities, legacy variant decoding, and selected upstream geometry/assets through the hash-verified private staging path.

Do not reintroduce retired custom foods/materials, Ant/ant hill/carried-food systems, snail shells, Froglass, Shellstone, antivenom, Whistle, plush bear, or protected-resource redistribution; retained tameable pets use owner-authorized empty-hand secondary-use FOLLOW/WANDER/STAY cycling.

exclusions: Tracked upstream All Rights Reserved resource directories, the pristine upstream JAR, and redistribution claims beyond the preserved license.
Legacy status/history narratives, generated output, caches, diagnostics, and unretained artifacts.
Runtime deployment outside the dedicated Workbench, displacement of another project's testing slot, Player Instance mutation, and protected gameplay-instance access.
Matcha-specific spawn tuning or other new gameplay policy during the preservation port.
